lines.pattern: In week one, 43 of your 68 plays were distorted guitars in a wall of sound and 12 were fingerpicked nylon guitar. In week four it had turned around: 7 of 58 plays were the wall of sound and 35 of 58 were the nylon guitar.
lines.receipt: Wall of sound: 43 of 68 plays in week one (63%), 7 of 58 in week four (12%). Nylon guitar: 12 of 68 in week one (18%), 35 of 58 in week four (60%).
offers: Have you settled into something calmer these past weeks, so the noise stopped fitting?
Or have your days been loud enough on their own that the quiet guitar is all the sound you want right now?
